Answers are generated by Anthropic Claude Haiku, with Voyage AI voyage-4-lite embeddings, and content is stored in Supabase Postgres with pgvector plus Postgres full-text search for hybrid retrieval [3]. Upstash Redis handles per-IP rate limiting, and GitHub Actions re-ingests content and runs evals on pull requests [3].
